veranderings.voor: sê net vir ander wat om te doen
veranderings.na: sê net vir ander wat hulle moet doen
veranderings.rede: 'wat om te doen' copies English 'what to do'; 'wat hulle moet doen' is the idiomatic Afrikaans form.
The quoted trait follows 'is' directly and reads as broken grammar; a colon marks it as the list item's name and leaves the protected wording intact.

veranderings.voor: Die tweede eienskap vra dat sy
veranderings.na: Die tweede eienskap beteken dat sy
veranderings.rede: 'vra' was just used for the leader asking people, and a trait that 'asks that she' reads wooden; 'beteken' is clearer for Grade 4.

veranderings.voor: vra ook na die span se idees en gebruik die beste idee
veranderings.na: vra ook die span vir hulle idees en gebruik die beste een
veranderings.rede: 'vra na' means to ask after or inquire about; 'iemand vir iets vra' is the natural construction, and 'die beste een' avoids repeating 'idee'.

beskerm_bedenkings.rede: In the list it is the only item starting with a capital letter; the other seven start lower case, so the list looks inconsistent. Only the case would change, not the words.
